description: Inputs passed to the Pharos risk-adjusted treasury policy WASM at evaluation time

stablecoin_id.description: Canonical Pharos stablecoin identifier in ticker-issuer form, e.g. 'usdc-circle'. This is the key every Pharos endpoint is queried on.

transaction_amount_usd.description: USD notional of the proposed acquisition, used to size the position against available exit liquidity. CALLER-SUPPLIED and therefore NOT attested - see this pack's README. Defaults to 0 when omitted, which makes the exit-capacity ratio undefined and fail-soft.

max_slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points used to pick which exit-liquidity observation to read. Defaults to 50 (0.5%).

stress_lookback_days.description: Lookback window in days for the Pharos stress-signal history. Defaults to 7.
